meta.name: receiving-code-review
meta.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

copy.tagline: 审慎处理代码审查反馈，验证后再实施
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果收到代码审查意见时想先验证再修改
copy.tagline_en: Handle code review feedback with verification before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to verify code review feedback before implementing changes

howto.what: 收到代码评审反馈后，Claude 会先通读并用自己的话复述需求，再对照代码库核实；不清楚就问，不盲目执行。确认无误后逐条实施并单独测试；若反馈技术上有误，会用技术理由反驳，而不是客套附和。
howto.when: 当用户把代码评审反馈转给 Claude、准备实施之前，尤其是反馈表述不清或技术上存疑的时候。

say.text: 这条评审意见我看不懂，先别动手，帮我解释清楚再改。
say.note: 触发先澄清、后实施的流程。

say.text: 评审建议加个专业功能，先查一下代码里有没有人用这个接口。
say.note: 触发 YAGNI 检查，避免加无用功能。

say.text: 反馈有好几条，先按阻断问题、简单修复、复杂重构的顺序来。
say.note: 按原文实施顺序逐项处理并测试。

howto.what_en: Receiving code review feedback, Claude restates the requirement, verifies against the codebase, and clarifies unclear items before implementing. It pushes back with technical reasoning on questionable suggestions, then implements one at a time, testing each.
howto.when_en: When the user shares code review feedback and expects implementation, especially if the feedback seems unclear or technically questionable.

say_en.text: This review comment is unclear. Pause and explain before changing anything.
Reviewer wants a feature. Check if the codebase uses this endpoint first.
Multiple items. Fix blockers, then simple fixes, then complex refactors.
